description: This file defines the class Smarty_Resource_Mysqls which implements a MySQL-based resource handler for Smarty templates, including database connection setup, template fetching, and related logic.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Mysqls
classes.description: A resource class for Smarty templates using MySQL as storage, extending Smarty_Resource_Custom and handling database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL connection using PDO and prepares the statement to fetch templates.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a template's source and modification time from the database based on the template name.
